attributes.board_name: Indiana Physical Therapy Committee (Indiana Professional Licensing Agency)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Only approved continuing competency activities: courses by APTA, APTA Indiana (INAPTA), FSBPT, US Department of Education, Council on Postsecondary Education, Joint Commission, federal/state/local government agencies, their affiliated entities, and accredited colleges (no prior Committee approval needed); other activities if approved by the Committee as directly related to PT practice, management or education.
rules.new_licensee_rule: License valid less than 12 months at renewal: no CE. Valid 12-23 months: 12 hours, including the 2-hour ethics and Indiana jurisprudence course.
rules.carryover: Not allowed; hours must be earned within the biennial renewal period.
rules.audit_note: Audits for compliance are conducted as provided in IC 25-1-4. Keep proof of content (brochure/agenda) and certificates of completion.

topics.who: Ethics and Indiana jurisprudence course as it relates to the practice of physical therapy; counts toward the 22 hours

rules.notes: Same rule for PT licenses and PTA certifications. Licenses expire June 30 of even-numbered years; renewal fee $100.
